turns.prompt_text: I'd like to purchase toothpicks in bulk for use in art, I would like a variety of quality, that is, a bulk amount of cheap ones for rough drafts, and some better quality ones for a final draft
turns.response_html:
Structuring your toothpick supply by quality tier is an excellent approach for physical prototyping and structural modeling. This prevents wasting premium, straight-grain wood on rough structural layouts while ensuring your final architectural scale model or sculpture remains sturdy and aesthetically neat.

Here are the best bulk options categorized for both drafting and final production.

For Rough Drafts (Ultra-Cheap & Plentiful)

When prototyping geometric shapes or testing adhesive cure times, volume and low cost are key. These standard wooden options provide massive quantities so you can build, break, and alter layouts without worrying about material waste.

  • Royal Paper R820 Round Wooden Toothpicks - 800/Box: A great mid-scale bulk option for a home studio. These all-white birch picks are burr-free and smooth, making them clean enough to handle easily but cheap enough to use casually for temporary supports.
  • Creativity Street Round Wood Toothpicks: Specifically packaged for arts, crafts, and classroom projects. These are highly economical and work beautifully as low-relief texture elements, stir sticks for resins, or structural filler pieces.

For Final Drafts (Premium Strength & Straightness)

For final production, look for dense fibers like bamboo or selected high-grade white birch. Bamboo offers exceptional tensile strength, uniform thickness, and straightness, meaning individual pieces are less likely to warp under the tension of wood glue or snap under slight structural loads.

  • Bamboo Wooden Toothpicks: Made from high-quality natural bamboo, these boast a superior sturdiness that resists cracking, soaking, or chipping when interacting with heavy adhesives or acrylic mediums.
  • Comfy Package Bamboo Wooden Toothpicks: Offering a double-pointed design, these dense bamboo picks provide clean, sharp tips on both ends. This is incredibly helpful when pinning multi-point intersections or building intricate lattice frameworks.

Product Recommendations

Summary Recommendation

For a dual-tier setup, grab a box of the Royal Paper R820 for your quick structural trials and layout mockups. Pair them with a pack of the Bamboo Wooden Toothpicks for final assembly, as the natural rigidity of bamboo will hold up significantly better under tension and provide a crisper, more uniform look.

If you are working on a specific type of art structure, let me know if you need options with specific traits—such as square/flat profiles rather than round, or extra-long lengths for larger scale models.

Walmart is your best single stop if you want to grab both tiers at the same time for the lowest price.

  • For Final Drafts: They stock Thyme & Table Natural Bamboo Toothpicks (300-Piece) and Evriholder Bamboo Toothpicks (500 Pack) right on the shelf, giving you the stiffer, splinter-free bamboo material needed for tight joints.

2. Target (Duff Ave)

Target is excellent for stocking up on an enormous quantity of very cheap drafting picks.

  • For Final Drafts: They carry Chef Craft Bamboo Toothpicks (500 Count), which come bundled with plastic storage holders.

3. Hy-Vee (West & East Locations)

Both the Lincoln Way (West) and Grand Ave (East) grocery locations keep toothpicks stocked in their baking or food storage aisles.

4. Dollar General & Hobby Lobby
